pages.heading: Welcome
body: Welcome to the Impact Asia Summit. For four days we gather in Phoenix, in the heart of the Sonoran Desert, to rethink the next step for technology, leadership and stewardship — grounded in faith.
This handbook is your companion for the week: programme, venue, tracks and practical notes are all here. May these days become a turning point for your life and your work.

items.v: Fly into Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)
About 15–25 minutes by car to the venue in Tempe
A modern desert oasis in the Valley of the Sun, known as the Silicon Desert
Arizona does not observe DST; 15 hours behind Taiwan

items.a: All summit sessions across four days, plus five meals. The fee is quoted in TWD and excludes flights and lodging.

items.q: Until when is the early-bird price?
items.a: Through 2026/09/30 at NT$12,600; afterwards the standard NT$18,000 applies.

items.q: What if I can no longer attend?
items.a: Transferring your place is preferred. Email service@ct.org.tw by Oct 13 with the change.

pages.heading: Before You Come
body: Carry your passport and registration confirmation, and wear your badge throughout the venue.
Phoenix has a wide day-to-night temperature swing in October — dress in layers and bring sun protection and moisturiser.
Please silence phones during sessions; follow on-site staff for photography and filming.

pages.line: May this journey become a turning point for your life and your work.
